title: dryopteris argentea
intro: Dryopteris argentea, commonly known as silver fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include the ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and lower cholesterol levels. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris argentea include antimicrobial, antifungal, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
